newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-RUSSIA'S KAMAZ IN SHOCK AFTER TWO 5-0 DEFEATS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RUSSIA'S KAMAZ IN SHOCK AFTER TWO 5-0 DEFEATS.

text.p: Two 5-0 defeats in their first two games of the Russian premier league season have left KamAZ in a state of shock.
"In both games the team broke down after letting in a second goal," coach Beniaminas Zelkiavichius said after his side lost to Rotor Volgograd on Friday. "We've got to work on our playing style."
The Lithuanian trainer acknowledged KamAZ's biggest problem seemed to be lasting a full 90 minutes. In both matches they trailed just 1-0 going into the final quarter.
Earlier this month, Zelkiavichius said the club from Naberezhniye Chelny in the ethnic republic of Tatarstan in central Russia might struggle to avoid relegation.
It took a an extraordinary 5-4 away win on the final day of the 1996 season to save KamAZ from the drop.
